Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrite positivity, and presence of bacteria. Glucosuria is noted, possibly reflecting hyperglycemia or renal threshold alteration. Low urine specific gravity may suggest impaired concentrating ability. Recommend clinical correlation, assessment for diabetes, and prompt antimicrobial therapy as indicated.
